question: Averaged over Mapbox's own pixel, or three pixels, does USGS's lidar agree with Mapbox's height at C-030's 468 points?

facts.fact: The point height from C-030 lies within the one-pixel square's lidar range at 95% of points or more
Every place has 90% of points within 0.5 m with lidar averaged over one pixel
Every place has 90% of points within 0.5 m with lidar averaged over three pixels
On flat ground (lidar spans under 0.25 m across three pixels), fewer than 25% of points are more than 0.5 m off
